cases.expected: initializeValidators() is invoked exactly once on each schema in the list and canShortCircuit() is called once; no exception is thrown.
cases.description: Validate that with a non‑empty list of mock JsonSchema objects the method iterates over all schemas, calls initializeValidators() on each, and then calls canShortCircuit() to cache the short‑circuit flag.

cases.expected: initializeValidators() is invoked exactly three times (once per schema) and canShortCircuit() is called once; no exception is thrown.
cases.description: Same as above but with three schemas to ensure the loop processes every element.

cases.expected: canShortCircuit() is invoked exactly once; initializeValidators() is never invoked; no exception is thrown.
cases.description: When the validator is constructed with an empty List<JsonSchema>, the loop body is skipped. Verify that only the short‑circuit cache method is called and the method completes normally.

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown when attempting to iterate over a null schemas field.
cases.description: Simulate a situation where the internal `schemas` field is null (e.g., via reflection). The method should fail with NPE because it tries to iterate over a null collection.

cases.expected: The exception thrown by the first schema's initializeValidators() propagates out of preloadJsonSchema; canShortCircuit() is never called.
cases.description: Inject a mock JsonSchema whose `initializeValidators()` method throws a RuntimeException. Verify that the method does not swallow the exception and that short‑circuit caching is not performed.

cases.expected: initializeValidators() is invoked once per list entry (twice for the duplicate), canShortCircuit() is called once; no exception is thrown.
cases.description: Provide a list containing the same mock JsonSchema object twice. Ensure the loop does not de‑duplicate entries and calls `initializeValidators()` for each occurrence.

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown when the loop reaches the null element while calling initializeValidators().
cases.description: Create a list `[validSchema, null, anotherValidSchema]`. The method should attempt to invoke `initializeValidators()` on the null entry, resulting in NPE.

cases.expected: RuntimeException is propagated out of preloadJsonSchema; initializeValidators() is called for each schema before the exception, but canShortCircuit() throws and is not caught.
cases.description: Create a subclass of OneOfValidator that overrides canShortCircuit() to throw a RuntimeException. Provide a non‑empty schemas list with mock JsonSchema objects whose initializeValidators() succeed. Verify that the exception from canShortCircuit() propagates and no further processing occurs.

cases.expected: ConcurrentModificationException is propagated out of preloadJsonSchema; canShortCircuit() is never called.
cases.description: Inject a mock JsonSchema whose initializeValidators() method removes an element from the underlying schemas list (or adds a new one). When the for‑each loop continues, the JVM detects the concurrent modification and throws ConcurrentModificationException. Verify that the exception bubbles up and the short‑circuit cache method is not invoked.

cases.expected: IllegalStateException is propagated out of preloadJsonSchema; canShortCircuit() is never called.
cases.description: Replace the internal `schemas` field with a custom List implementation whose iterator() method throws IllegalStateException. When preloadJsonSchema() attempts to start the for‑each loop, the exception is thrown immediately. Verify that the method does not catch it and that canShortCircuit() is not executed.
